note: Cameras oriented on 29 October 2026, after the run 20261027T220006-4e3e was signed, each by an annotator (a Claude Code subagent) from the frames, OpenStreetMap and SRTM terrain only: CBET 3423, the fitted path and the files that hold them (validation/, final_solution.json, the Monte Carlo files, web/data) were out of bounds, the fireball's track was not used, and the camera was frozen before its lines of sight were compared with the path. Each was then checked against the fitted path (scripts/holdout.py, validation/chelyabinsk-2013/holdout-after-run.json). The agent never reads this folder (src/ does not read validation/), so none of it is among the signed run's inputs, and the run replays unchanged. Only Yekaterinburg's evidence was judged sufficient before the check, and only its camera is drawn in the viewer, as a check on the fit like Tyumen; scripts/stations.py refits it from lines-81.json and horizon-81.json. Plast, Chebarkul and Magnitogorsk were judged rough before the check: their camera fits are used in no solution and drawn nowhere, and only their held-out numbers and what their frames show about camera motion are quoted, as the record of the attempt. Beloretsk's car turns through the first 5 s of its trimmed clip and stands still from there to the end of SAM's track (the last 6 s of the fireball); an attempt on those still frames was not finished.

chelyabinsk-2013-238.why: The heading rests on one chimney (OSM way 306339927, 1.1 km away) and the field of view on the bearing of a road that OSM maps only since 2019; leaving either out sends the field of view to about 90 deg. chelyabinsk-2013-15.how: by an annotator (a Claude Code subagent) from the frames, OpenStreetMap and SRTM terrain only: CBET 3423, the fitted path and the files that hold them (validation/, final_solution.json, the Monte Carlo files, web/data) were out of bounds, the fireball's track was not used, and the camera was frozen before its lines of sight were compared with the path
chelyabinsk-2013-15.why: The heading rests on one soft landmark, the far end of road 75K-277 where cars first appear at the frame's left edge. Nothing else surveyable is in view, so the field of view is not measured: the dawn glow bounds it to 77.5 to 98.7 deg, it was set at 88 deg, and across that range the heading moves from 80.4 to 91.5 deg. Where the car stood is uncertain. The frames shift by at most 1.4 px, so Muse Spark's reading that the camera moves is not borne out.
chelyabinsk-2013-15.image_note: a virtual 1280 x 1080 frame whose top 720 rows are the video's: the plumb lines put the principal point about 180 px below the frame's centre; video pixels are used unchanged

chelyabinsk-2013-257.how: by an annotator (a Claude Code subagent) from the frames, OpenStreetMap and SRTM terrain only: CBET 3423, the fitted path and the files that hold them (validation/, final_solution.json, the Monte Carlo files, web/data) were out of bounds, the fireball's track was not used, and the camera was frozen before its lines of sight were compared with the path
chelyabinsk-2013-257.why: The heading rests on one chimney chosen by judgement: the smoke column is taken to come from the two 180 m stacks of the steel works' oxygen-converter shop, 4.4 km away, and other stacks would move it by -5.7 or +19.9 deg. The field of view could not be measured (set at 113 deg from soft bounds; 109 to 117 deg is plausible), and the yard in the frame does not match the buildings OSM maps at the catalogue point. The frames shift by at most 0.15 px, so Muse Spark's reading that the camera moves is not borne out.
